description: Shared single source of truth for the abstract state machine of the rolling-restart active-gate / snapshot-coverage convergence protocol with owner handoff. Both the fast-check executable model (test/model/active-gate) and the TLA+ specification (models/active-gate/ActiveGate.tla) MUST mirror exactly these state variables and actions. The Phase D drift lint (test/model/active-gate/manifest-drift.test.js) fails if any surface diverges.
convergence: published == Nodes AND fresh == TRUE AND Cardinality(covered) >= Quorum (Quorum = floor(|Nodes|/2)+1)

realReducerOracle.binding: For every reachable abstract state, the abstract convergence predicate MUST equal buildPublicationActiveGateCatchupFence(options).promotionAllowed, where options = { expectedNodeIds: Nodes, publishedActiveNodeIds: published, snapshotCoverage: { nodeIds: covered, fresh } }.
